GetAssemblies()

Get all assemblies in the current app domain based on the first part of the namespace from the EntryAssembly or ExecutingAssembly. Example: Namespace [FirstPart].[SecondPart] will return all assemblies that starts with [FirstPart].

LoadTypes(string, Func<TypeInfo, bool>, IEnumerable<Assembly>, Assembly)

Loads types into the cache. Then the types can be fetched using the GetServiceTypePairs (without a filter). See 'GetAssemblies' in 'AssemblyService' for default behaviour.
